name: URTC-TESTER
build: Standalone Python desktop tool. pip install -r requirements.txt; it starts the Qt Quick diagnostics deck.
notes: Live CAN-bus diagnostic tool including CSV export of live graphs, exercised only against fake transports and never against a real board. The Qt Quick deck is the only interface and starts in listen-only mode. Every output the screens send goes through the encoders in advanced_protocol.py, which reject out-of-range values instead of clamping them.
